question: By what count and in what kind of womb-diagrams are certain beings said to be tormented?
premises: Torment is said to occur in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
The location specified is a set of womb-diagrams counted in thousands.
The beings in question are described as tormented within those locations.
inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, they are tormented.
